explanation.headline: Linezolid is not on FDA's shortage list; internal supply imbalance shows Corvale East at 5.3 days on hand versus Corvale General at 24 days

sentences.text: FDA's records show linezolid is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 76 tablets of the 600 mg presentation with a daily use of 14.4, giving 5.3 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 387 tablets of the same presentation with a daily use of 16.1, giving 24 days on hand.
Both sites' product carries NDC 67877041920 labeled by Ascend Laboratories, LLC and linked to SPL set 7402aa01.
That SPL set names Alkem Laboratories Limited (FEI 3006370524) as the registered manufacturing plant.
FDA inspection history for that plant shows VAI classifications in 2011, 2013, 2016, and 2018 with no OAI or recent NAI posted.
The ranked transfer option moves 127 tablets from Corvale General to Corvale East, leaving the sender above two weeks and bringing the receiver to 14 days.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
